2340.a: L’Atelier de Stand Banh Mi, 1 Chome-3-21 Jiyugaoka, Meguro City, Tokyo 152-0035, Japan
2340.aj: 〒152-0035 東京都目黒区自由が丘１丁目３−２１ ラトリエ ドゥ スタンドバインミー
2340.ed: Diners like this Vietnamese restaurant's flavorful, additive-free dishes, including pho and banh mi, which are beautifully presented. They also highlight the cozy, sophisticated atmosphere and attentive staff, noting it's a great spot for dates or casual meals. Other reviews mention the food can be overpriced.
2340.edj: クチコミによると、このベトナム料理店では、フォーやバインミーなど、見た目も美しい風味豊かな無添加料理が高く評価されています。また、居心地の良い洗練された雰囲気と気の利くスタッフも特徴で、デートやカジュアルな食事にもおすすめのようです。 一方で、料理の値段が割高というクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I gave stars for atmosphere almost. I wanted to have some bahn mi so I went here because i always go to Jiyuugaoka every Saturday. To be honest, it was not meet my expectations I meant I have ever had more better one. Here the atmosphere was very good I expected a lot. I like Vietnam coffee but here it was not different from my country tho And you know since the location is in jiyugaoka and it was really expensive…

Pretty good Vietnamese restaurant near Jiyugaoka. I ordered the curry chicken with rice dish. Flavor was really good, but only came with a few small pieces of chicken. Also ordered the ginger drink which was a little pricey, but taste was really good. I ate outside in from and they had heaters and blankets to help keep you warm. Staff was friendly, restaurant was nicely decorated, and bathroom was clean. Overall a…

This small restaurant is a true gem, an oasis of authentic Vietnamese cuisine with a delicate touch of Japanese influences. The flavors are simply delicious and deeply convincing, a culinary experience that never betrays its Vietnamese roots. For natural wine lovers, it's a real pleasure to pair these exquisite dishes with a glass of selected wine.

2340.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2341.a: Hachi Coffee, 2 Chome-4-1 Yutenji, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0052, Japan
2341.aj: 〒153-0052 東京都目黒区祐天寺２丁目４−１ ハチコーヒー 祐天寺

rv.t: Very affordable price and many choices for beans are available. The beans are single origin from Indonesia, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Brazil, Colombia, Yemen, to Panama and Hawaii, and many more. Has a nice, homey, mom and pop shop vibe to it. The owner roasts the beans immediately after you order and you can choose between three roast levels (Light / 浅煎り, medium /中煎り, dark / 深煎り). Also sells snacks, mugs, and coffee…

Great little order made roastery with about 20 different coffee bean varieties from all over the world to choose from. Super friendly owner and great variety from cheaper beans to very exotic ones. Good value compared to buying at coffee shops.
my favorite coffee roaster in entire Tokyo - nothing changes much over the years: good quality beans at a decent price and great service!

2341.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

2342.a: Japan, 〒153-0052 Tokyo, Meguro City, Yutenji, 2 Chome−5−5 kuku cafe
2342.aj: 〒153-0052 東京都目黒区祐天寺２丁目５−５ kuku cafe
2342.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, hearty hot dogs, and popular anko-butter sandwiches, with Wi-Fi and power outlets available. They also highlight the calm, relaxing atmosphere and the friendly, attentive staff. Other reviews mention the food can be disappointing.
2342.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいコーヒー、ボリュームのあるホットドッグ、人気のあんバターサンドが提供されており、Wi-Fiと電源が利用できると評価されています。また、落ち着いたリラックスできる雰囲気と、親切で気の利くスタッフも高く評価されています。 一方で、料理の味が期待通りではなかったというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: We found this cafe a bit so so... not bad but hardly anything great really. The coffee was OK, but the food was rather disappointing. The cake was less than supermarket quality. The atmosphere is a bit cold. I think they could do a lot better with the place. The lady who served us was very friendly though.

I was in the area and just happened to walk past this place so thought I’d stop in for a cup of coffee. This used to be a Scandinavian cafe so it’s opened in the last several months. It’s part of a an indoor golf facility, which is located downstairs. The coffee was good with several bean options choose from. They also have sweets and I went with the cheesecake, which was your standard version and tasty. Another…
New to the area and I really like this cafe. It's always nice and chilled and the drip coffee is delicious. The staff are lovely.

2343.a: Shokunoeki Pasar Miyoshiten, 2204 Kamitome, Miyoshi, Iruma District, Saitama 354-0045, Japan
2343.aj: 〒354-0045 埼玉県入間郡三芳町上富２２０４ 食の駅 Pasar三芳店
catj: ファーマーズ マーケット
2343.ed: Reviewers consistently praise this rest stop for its wide variety of local produce and diverse selection of specialty items. Furthermore, they appreciate the convenient access from both the highway and local roads, along with the clean and well-maintained facilities. Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
2343.edj: クチコミによると、この休憩所は、新鮮な地元産の野菜や、多種多様な特産品が豊富に揃っていると高く評価されています。また、高速道路からも一般道からもアクセスしやすく、施設が清潔で手入れが行き届いている点も好評のようです。 一方で、スタッフの対応があまり良くないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Good place for rest during the road trip. Little crowded but still very good place.
Decent food court

改めて埼玉県は野菜の種類が多く豊かなんだなって感じられる場所でした。 季節の野菜をあれもこれもと選んでいたら数千円行ってしまいましたがなかなか来ることが無いので満足でした！ 地元三芳町産のコーナーが設けてあったのですが、初めて見た「ワインドレス」が上品な苦みで新しい発見が出来たし、新鮮中の新鮮って感じで良かったです。ちなみに「ワインドレス」は、大手種苗会社であるタキイ種苗が開発したそうで、ファイトリッチシリーズという機能性野菜のひとつで、鮮やかな赤ワイン色が特徴でサニーレタスの一種だそうです。勉強～

2344.a: Takasaka Service Area, 981-3 Tagi, Higashimatsuyama, Saitama 355-0053, Japan
2344.aj: 〒355-0053 埼玉県東松山市田木９８１−３ 高坂サービスエリア (上下集約)

rv.t: 関越自動車道にあるサービスエリアです。 上りのSAと下りのSAがつながっており、どちらに駐車しても徒歩で相互に移動できます。 そのおかげでめちゃくちゃ広く感じます（実際に広いわけですが）。 上りと下りで雰囲気が違うので、一度にどちらも寄れるのは嬉しいですね。 ドッグランもあり休憩にとてもいいんですが、全体的に結構混んでいて空いている席は見つけにくくなっています。
広いサービスエリアです。トイレの収容数も多い。 ご飯はイマイチいい店がないと感じますが、キッチンカーも含め色々な種類は用意されています。 地域の栗を使った栗ソフトクリームは美味しかったです。
埼玉県東松山市にある関越自動車道のサービスエリア。上り線と下り線の施設が階段で繋がっており、両方の施設の相互利用が可能となっている。

2345.a: Asami Reizou, 781-4 Nagatoro, 長瀞町 Nagatoro, Chichibu District, Saitama 369-1305, Japan
2345.aj: 〒369-1305 埼玉県秩父郡長瀞町長瀞７８１−４ 阿左美冷蔵 寶登山道店
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2345.ed: Busy dessert shop dispensing shaved ice bases with sauces like squeezed orange & red bean paste.
2345.edj: みかんの果汁やあんこをかけたかき氷が楽しめる人気店。

rv.t: I visited on June 5 2026 @15:00. I travelled from Mito ibaraki for a sightseeing in Nagatoro and Chichibu.. The shaved ice (with strawberry milk syrup) was heavenly delicious .. staffs were very friendly and accommodating. They even gave me English menu 😁 very kind staff indeed.. Thank you 😊 ご馳走様でした😍 please open a branch in Mito 😀

Most popular shaved ice shop in Nagatoro. Their ice is not made by freezer. They use natural ice. So when you eat it don’t need to bite like as general shaved ice. It will be naturally melt in your mouth. Price is pretty expensive even though just shaved ice. This is only negative point.

Came here on mid September 2022 around noon. We didn't have to wait for long even though there was 4 groups in front of us. Our kakigori came right after we ordered it (less than a minute). IMO overall the kakigori tasted nice but rather pricey.

2345.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2346.a: Urushi Kobo YAMASHITA, 727-1 Nagatoro, Chichibu District, Saitama 369-1305, Japan
2346.aj: 〒369-1305 埼玉県秩父郡長瀞町長瀞７２７−１ ギャラリー喫茶 やました
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2346.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious shaved ice, especially the homemade syrups and flavorful toppings, and also enjoy the soft warabi mochi. They also highlight the warm, traditional, and relaxing atmosphere, with some mentioning it's a great spot for a quiet break. Guests appreciate the friendly staff and convenient parking.
2346.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいかき氷、特に自家製シロップと風味豊かなトッピングが高く評価されています。また、やわらかいわらび餅も人気です。温かく、伝統的で落ち着いた雰囲気も特徴で、静かに休憩するのに最適な場所だと感じる人もいます。親しみやすいスタッフと便利な駐車場も好評です。

rv.t: Dessert here is really worth to try. Warabi mochi with red bean, ice cream is great. Matcha tastes good and smooth. Caramel pudding here is very tasty.
If you visit Nagatoro, this is you must visit cafe for the dessert. Must try shaved ice with various kinds of flavors! Highly recommend Warabi Mochi and Azuki(red bean) shaved ice!
Excellent place!! Nice view with good food, absolutely make my day ❤️enjoy Sakura rain I love Japan! (Pizza, cake and coffee)

2346.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2347.a: Nagatoro Station, Nagatoro, Chichibu District, Saitama 369-1305, Japan
2347.aj: 〒369-1305 埼玉県秩父郡長瀞町長瀞長瀞駅
2347.ed: People say this station has a charming, retro wooden building and is a convenient hub for local attractions like river cruises and hiking. They also highlight the availability of coin lockers, clean public restrooms, and ample parking. Some reviews mention platform access can be difficult.
2347.edj: クチコミによると、この駅は趣のあるレトロな木造建築で、ライン下りやハイキングなど、周辺の観光地へのアクセスに便利な拠点として評価されています。また、コインロッカーや清潔な公衆トイレ、十分な駐車スペースがあることも好評のようです。 一方で、ホームへのアクセスが難しいという意見もあります。

rv.t: The energy of river, rapids and gorge meets the platform here; the station hums with summer laughter, autumn leaves and hikers’ boots. You feel the world push forward but the train holds you still, poised between thrill and calm. Tourist Tip: From the station it's a short walk to the river-cruise boarding point or rock walk. Consider staying late for sunset over the gorge if your schedule allows.
I visited Chichibu station to ride Japanese traditional steam locomotive. And then, there a lot of souvenir and desert shop round here. It's a nice trip for oneday trip👍
This small town all tell stories of traditional Japanese summer styles without words.

2348.a: tomoru chaya, 1 Chome-6-1 Shin-Kiba, Koto City, Tokyo 136-0082, Japan
2348.aj: 〒136-0082 東京都江東区新木場１丁目６−１ tomoru茶屋
catj: ブランチ レストラン
2348.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and healthy set meals, including flavorful pho and coconut chicken curry, with quick service. They also highlight the calm and comfortable atmosphere, making it a good spot for a relaxed meal. Some reviews mention the menu can be limited.
2348.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、風味豊かなフォーやココナッツチキンカレーなど、美味しくて健康的な定食を評価しています。料理の提供が早いというクチコミが多くあります。また、店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で快適に過ごせるため、ゆっくりと食事を楽しみたい人におすすめのようです。 一方で、メニューの種類が限られているという意見もあります。

rv.t: Good

The food is amazing but they serve you too much food, we ordered a meal for two and shared it around the five of us. The Katsu Chicken Curry was amazing and was listed on the menu as Asian-style chicken curry.

先日妹が朝食利用して良かったと言っていたので、ホテルは何度も宿泊してますが、初めて朝食を利用しました。 朝から激混みしてないのと、天井も高くゆったり静かに利用出来ました。 料理の品数は多くはないけど、一通り揃ってるし、料理を取って席に戻る動線もコンパクトでポイント高いです。 アジア風カレー、フォー、豆腐ハンバーグ、白玉餅が良かった。 暑い日だったので、しっかり食べてTDRへ出掛けられました。 以前利用したディナータイムもオススメですが、時々貸し切り営業があるので、利用予定がある時は確認した方が良いと思います。

2348.stj: 営業中 · 営業終了: 10:00 · 再開時間: 11:30

2350.a: Japan, 〒414-0051 Shizuoka, Itō, Yoshida, 829-5 Repos カフェ
2350.aj: 〒414-0051 静岡県伊東市吉田８２９−５ Repos カフェ
2350.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and hearty dishes, including garlic rice curry and pasta, and appreciate the fluffy chiffon cake and deep-roasted coffee. They also highlight the calm, warm, and relaxing atmosphere, with classical music playing. Guests mention the kind staff and reasonable prices for lunch sets and dessert.
2350.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ガーリックライスやカレー、パスタなど、美味しくてボリュームのある料理が高く評価されています。ふわふわのシフォンケーキや深煎りのコーヒーも好評です。また、クラシック音楽が流れる落ち着いた温かい雰囲気も特徴です。スタッフの対応も親切で、ランチセットやデザートが手頃な価格で楽しめるという声が多くあります。

rv.t: This is a very quiet and calm Cafe. It feels like a very different experience for those who come from Tokyo. I reserved the place for dinner with a course menu. It was really tasty and the staff was even so nice that they offered to drive us back to the place we stayed while being here. We enjoyed our meal here so much, that we decided to come the next day for lunch as well. It was really great. Because it's so…

Amazing atmosphere! The food was incredible, so much love and care put into it. We were very happy taking a break at this place and got chatting to the owners, they are very kind people, and helped us out with directions. We’d love to go again! They also sell lovely traditional house accessories.
Nice and calm place, near a beautiful lake. The old couple is really kind, the pound cake was delicious. 100% recommended if you pass by it!

2350.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:00（土）

2351.a: Ao Terrace _ Izu Panorama Park, 260-1 Osaka, Izunokuni, Shizuoka 410-2203, Japan
2351.aj: 〒410-2203 静岡県伊豆の国市小坂２６０−１ 碧テラス
2351.ed: Visitors say this park offers breathtaking panoramic views of Mount Fuji and Suruga Bay, with well-maintained facilities including a cafe, foot bath, and walking trails. They also highlight the convenient ropeway access to the summit and the availability of private gazebos for a luxurious experience. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, enhancing the overall visit.
2351.edj: この公園を訪れた人からは、富士山と駿河湾の息をのむようなパノラマの景色が楽しめるというクチコミが多くあります。カフェや足湯、散策路など、施設もきれいに整備されていると評判です。山頂へのアクセスには便利なロープウェイがあり、贅沢な体験ができるプライベートガゼボも利用できると好評です。スタッフは親切で対応が良いという声もあり、全体的に満足度の高い訪問になっているようです。

rv.t: This is a very nice park. There is a long cable car ride to the top, and the views are incredible. There is a very nice boardwalk with a forest section, and a Mt Fuji lookout point. The restauarnt at the bottom has excellent pizza. One tip is that you can buy pizza for takeout (at a reduced price) and take it with you to eat at the summit. There is lots of free parking. The tickets are a bit pricey at 3500 Yen per…

“Izu Panorama Park Ao Terrace is one of the best viewpoints in Japan! 🗻✨ On a clear day, you can enjoy breathtaking views of beautiful Mount Fuji and Suruga Bay. Relax with a delicious meal or a cup of coffee at the café and restaurant while taking in the spectacular scenery. Before you leave, visit the souvenir shop on the first floor to find unique gifts and local specialties from Izu. The location is easy to…

Sky Garden by Ao Terrace is a new mountaintop observation deck at Izu Panorama Park in Shizuoka, Japan, featuring stunning views of Mt. Fuji and Suruga Bay. Located on Mt. Katsuragi, the area includes a "Grand Loop" walkway, a Forest Walk, water basins for scenic reflections, and private seating, accessible via a 1,800-meter ropeway. The "Grand Loop" is a circular deck with 360-degree panoramas, while the "Forest…

2352.a: Izu Panorama Park, 山麓駅 1F 260-1 Nagaoka, Izunokuni, Shizuoka 410-2211, Japan
2352.aj: 〒410-2211 静岡県伊豆の国市長岡２６０−１ 山麓駅 1F 伊豆パノラマパーク
2352.ed: Scenic mountain park with vistas of of Mt. Fuji from its cablecar, viewing terrace & restaurant.
2352.edj: 風光明媚な山岳公園。ロープウェイ、展望テラス、レストランから富士山の雄大な姿を拝める。

rv.t: Izu Panorama Park was one of the highlights of our trip to Japan. It was the most relaxing day we had and a perfect way to spend our last day before leaving Tokyo. Getting there takes about two hours from Tokyo by Shinkansen, followed by a local train and a bus. The travel time is similar to many of the popular Mount Fuji day tours, but the biggest advantage is that you don't need to book anything in advance. It was…

Welcome onboard the ropeway to the summit of Katsuragi mountain, a resort facility with a great panoramic view! Please enjoy an extra ordinary experience like nowhere else from the open terrace with a great view of Mt. Fuji. Izu Panorama Park is a day use resort facility consists of the summit area with a terrace where you can take a great panoramic view from the summit of Katsuragi mountain, shop and restaurant…

Would come back again. We booked both the cable car ride and Terrace/Gazebo with snacks on KKDay 2 weeks in advance. 1. Views: 5/5. Surrounded by mountains and the ocean. 2. Terrace/Gazebo: 5/5. Comfortable and clean bedding and blankets, good privacy. 3. Tea cakes: 3/5. Pretty for the picture. Some mochis and the macarons were decent. Chocolate cake is a little dry. Small jelly flowers were too sweet for us. 4…

2353.a: Japan, 〒414-0022 Shizuoka, Itō, Higashimatsubaracho, 1 Chome−1 松川遊歩道
2353.aj: 〒414-0022 静岡県伊東市東松原町１丁目１ 松川遊歩道
2353.ed: People say this river walk offers a pleasant stroll along the Matsukawa River, featuring antique-style streetlights, weeping willows, and historic wooden ryokan inns. Visitors also highlight the beautiful night illumination with bamboo lanterns, creating a relaxing and picturesque atmosphere. Some reviews mention the path can be narrow.
2353.edj: クチコミによると、松川沿いの遊歩道は、アンティーク調の街灯やしだれ柳、歴史ある木造の旅館が並び、散策にぴったりな場所として知られています。特に夜間は、竹の灯籠による美しいライトアップが施され、幻想的で心安らぐ雰囲気を楽しめると評判です。 一方で、道幅が狭いという声もあります。

rv.t: Ryokan Inn from the eary 20th century, now a public museum. Small fee to tour the building. Too bad most of the descriptions of artifacts were in Japanese only. My poor JP reading skills made it difficult to read them. The building looks magical when viewed from the river walk at night.
Nice place to walk in the morning or evening. Not far from town and station.
Nice tranquil walk in/ out of Ito. No traffic. By the river.

2354.a: Kinema street arcade, 5-43 Matsukawacho, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0011, Japan
2354.aj: 〒414-0011 静岡県伊東市松川町５−４３ キネマ通り

rv.t: Very deserted shopping street with hardly any shops opened and has a funky odour that reeks of fish and cigarettes. As mentioned by others, it is very nostalgic and you can consider giving it a shot if it is convenient. But definitely not worth going out of your way to visit this location.
Many shops are closed in August due to corona
mostly closed when I visit on Sunday & Monday

2355.a: Japan, 〒414-0003 Shizuoka, Itō, Chuocho, 5−4 ねりものや 武
2355.aj: 〒414-0003 静岡県伊東市中央町５−４ ねりものや 武

rv.t: 1 泊2日の伊東旅行の初日に試食をいただき、まずは旅館で食べる分を買い、2日目にもお土産用に買って帰るくらい好みの味でした。 単に練り物に魚がのっていたりベーコンが巻かれているのではなく、一緒になっているから引き立て合ってとても美味しいです。 魚は生臭くないし、えびは表記通りにプリプリで、お酒にもよく合って夜食やおつまみに最適だと思います。 少し寂しい商店街にありますが、お店の方は気さくで、一層美味しくなる食べ方も教えていただけます。 その日の作り立てが開店時に外に並べられるので、早い時間帯に行くのもおすすめです。 是非食べてみてほしいです。

伊東の商店街歩いていたら、「ちんちん揚げ」なる登りが出てまして。んで、気になるのでw、店頭で売ってた品物をじろじろ見ていたら、いろいろと試食、いただけました。 あ、ちんちん揚げの名前の由来に関しては検索してみてください。 ちんちん揚げ以外は、基本、練り物の上に色々と海産物が乗ったかまぼこになっています。 って、簡単に書いたけど、これがすげーうまし！お値段はそこそこしますけど、どれも素材の旨さが前面に出てまして、間違いない美味しさ。ちなみに伊東の某有名宿でも、こちらの食材を使っているとのこと。 おすすめです。

伊東駅から歩いて5〜6分です こんなに美味しい蒲鉾を食べたのは初めてです ホテルで頂いた「金目鯛の蒲鉾」が美味しくてて伊東駅からぶらぶら歩いていたら偶然こちらのお店を見つけました すべて手作りされているそうで無添加もなく安心していただけます 種類が豊富で珍しい蒲鉾も沢山ありました 店頭でも試食させて頂き ふわふわで美味しかったです えびしんじょう、かます、金目鯛、ほたてベーコン全て美味しかったです ふわふわ食感も変わらず また旅行の際はぜひ立ち寄ります

2356.a: Banjō Falls, 776-1 Jizodo, Izu, Shizuoka 410-2515, Japan
2356.aj: 〒410-2515 静岡県伊豆市地蔵堂７７６−１ 萬城の滝
2356.ed: 20-meter-high waterfall next to a campground, with a picnic area & a beetle-sculpture restroom.
2356.edj: 落差 20 m の滝。ピクニック エリアやカブトムシ型トイレを備えたキャンプ場が近くにある。

rv.t: With all the rain we have had what better way to enjoy it than a trip to the waterfalls in this area. After the Banjo falls we walked along the river bank to the Curtain falls. Although the walking was relatively easy and quite beautiful alongside the river we turned around at the latter because we had a small dog with us. The path along the bank to the next interest poknt was clearly marked and we will be trying it…

Falls is relatively small but place is very quite.. This fall is near to rechamp. So car parking is not a issue. Public Toilets are near by. Regarding steps point of view; number of steps are very less when compared to other.Totally you can enjoy nature nicely
Clean and well-maintained. The waterfall and its rock formations are very beautiful, and the place is very peaceful. Definitely worth the trip out.

2357.a: Asian Old Bazaar Izu, 715-86 Kusumimotowada, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0045, Japan
2357.aj: 〒414-0045 静岡県伊東市玖須美元和田７１５−８６ アジアンオールドバザール伊豆
2357.ed: People say this place offers a wide variety of Asian goods, including clothing and accessories, and delicious, generously portioned Asian dishes like curry, nasi goreng, and crispy fried chicken. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, who provide excellent service. Visitors appreciate the unique, exotic atmosphere and the reasonable prices for both food and merchandise.
2357.edj: この場所を訪れた人は、衣料品やアクセサリーを含む幅広い種類のアジアン雑貨と、カレー、ナシゴレン、クリスピーフライドチキンなどの美味しくてボリュームのあるアジアン料理を高く評価しています。また、親切で気の利くスタッフによる素晴らしいサービスも特徴のようです。利用した人は、ユニークで異国情緒あふれる雰囲気と、食事と商品の手頃な価格に満足しているというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: I have been to Bali twice and walking into this place made me feel like I was there again. I’ve lived in Japan for over 13 years and now I like to find ethnic restaurants like the one at the Asian old bazaar for a change up from Japanese food.I also lived in Indonesia for eight months a long time ago, and I enjoyed the food Here. It was late June when I went so being inside was nice with the air-conditioning. But I…

A quaint Asian restaurant and tchotchke shop. A 15-minute drive from Ito station, the food is good and reasonable - big servings I may add! A quirky switch from the monopoly of Japanese restaurants around Ito area.

This place definitely takes you to a different resort, especially when it’s nice and sunny to sit outside. The food is not bad, could be a bit too greasy depending on what you order. We enjoyed anyway. The shop inside is also a lot to look at if you like things from Indonesia. The staffs are all nice and friendly.

2357.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

2358.a: Japan, 〒414-0044 Shizuoka, Itō, Kawana, 1429 小室山リッジウォークMISORA（Café•321）
2358.aj: 〒414-0044 静岡県伊東市川奈１４２９ 小室山リッジウォークMISORA（Café•321）
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2358.ed: People say this cafe offers stunning ocean and sky views from its large windows and outdoor terrace, along with a variety of drinks and snacks. They also highlight the calm atmosphere, comfortable seating, and clean restrooms. Others mention the staff are attentive and helpful, and the cafe provides a great spot for photos.
2358.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、大きな窓や屋外テラス席から海と空の素晴らしい景色を楽しめるというクチコミが多くあります。また、様々な種類の飲み物や軽食が提供されている点も評価されています。店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、座り心地の良い席が用意されており、お手洗いも清潔という声があります。スタッフは親切で対応が丁寧、写真撮影にぴったりの場所だという意見もあります。

rv.t: A beautiful cafe located on top of Misora. Serves tons of drinks as well as some cookies and snacks. The highlight is the back of the cafe where you can see a deck that shows the whole sea. There is also a glass corridor that sticks out:
Good place to have few minutes of rest. Drinks are quite normal. Coming for the view not the drink

Amazing cafe on top of a massive hill only accessible by a Chairlift, This small coffee shop nestled inside the hill itself has amazing coffee with very modern decor, The views are top notch and extremely varied at the top, One of my highlights of my recent trip to japan, highly recommended 👍🏽.

2358.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2359.a: Japan, 〒413-0231 Shizuoka, Itō, Futo, Galette Cafe HAPPAYA, 大室高原３−６００
2359.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸HAPPAYA 大室高原３−６００

rv.t: Amazing local lunch spot serving classic French Galette and Crêpe options in a super cute garden. Very close to Mt Omuro and Izu Shaboten Zoo by foot (uphill) or taxi (1000¥). The service is incredibly kind and I promise you will NOT want to leave. We came 2 times during our stay :)
We had an amazing breakfast here. The galettes were fantastic, the staff beyond friendly and very attentative. Thank you for a wonderful time!
Amazingly delicious!! Highly recommended!! Everything is well done.

2359.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2360.a: Kadowaki Suspension Bridge, 842-65 Futo, Itō, Shizuoka 413-0231, Japan
2360.aj: 〒413-0231 静岡県伊東市富戸８４２−６５ 門脇つり橋
2360.ed: Modest pedestrian suspension bridge spanning a 48-meter distance between two clifftops.
2360.edj: 2 つの岸壁にかかる、長さ 48 メートルの簡素な歩行者用吊り橋。

rv.t: Let me start by discussing the parking lot. If you are there for a quick stop of less than five minutes, it’s free. However, over 5 minutes it costs 500 yen and that’s the max cost for the entire day. There are other spots nearby besides the bridge and lighthouse. As for the lighthouse and local souvenir shop, it closes at 04:30 pm. The bridge itself boasts some of the best views of peninsula. Absolutely stunning!…

The natural view is awesome, the environment is plain, and not many people around, but you have to drive to this location as there’s no public transport. It takes around two hours to drive from Tokyo, an hour from Fujiyama. The parking fee is a flat ¥500.

Kadowaki suspension bridge is one of the attractions in Ido. Waking the bridge is quite a fascinating experience and does not really require much strength. A short 5 minute walk and it is next to the free access light tower.

2361.a: Niku no Mansei Kanda Ekimae, 2 Chome-13-25 Kajicho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0044, Japan
2361.aj: 〒101-0044 東京都千代田区鍛冶町２丁目１３−２５ 肉の万世 神田駅前店
2361.ed: People say this restaurant serves delicious hamburgers, yakiniku, and tonjiru. They also highlight the generous portions, the free refills of rice and wakame soup, and the comfortable, family-friendly atmosphere. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
2361.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しいハンバーグ、焼肉、豚汁を高く評価しています。また、ボリューム満点な点、ご飯とわかめスープがおかわり自由な点、そして家族連れでも安心して過ごせる快適な雰囲気が特徴です。 一方で、クチコミでは、料理の提供が遅いという意見もあります。

rv.t: Still as legendary as ever! Outstanding steak quality at the Kanda branch 🥩✨ ⚬ Nostalgia & Vibe: I used to be a regular at the main Akihabara building, so I was really sad when it closed down. However, visiting this Kanda Ekimae branch completely brought back those great memories! ⚬ Food Check: The steak quality remains top-notch! The beef is ridiculously tender and literally melts in your mouth—just as amazing as I…

I went there late afternoon. I would like to go Kashiwano(The next door restaurant), however, it was too late for lunch time. I prefer more Cracked Hamburg Steak… it’s too soft but tastes good. Tastes are good, but not my favorite one.
I ate at the BBQ restaurant on the second floor. Great service, friendly staff, excellent quality meat!!

2361.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2362.a: Arisan Taiwanese Restaurant, シントミプラザ稲荷 1F 2 Chome-2-5 Matsugaya, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0036, Japan
2362.aj: 〒111-0036 東京都台東区松が谷２丁目２−５ シントミプラザ稲荷 1F 台湾小皿料理 阿里山
2362.ed: Diners like this restaurant's Taiwanese beef tendon ramen, noting the tender beef tendon and flavorful broth, and also enjoy the pan-fried dumplings. They also highlight the reasonable prices for lunch sets, with many options under 1,000 yen. Guests mention the staff provides kind service and appreciate the acceptance of various payment methods like PayPay and Suica.
2362.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、台湾牛すじラーメンを高く評価しています。柔らかく煮込まれた牛すじと風味豊かなスープが特徴のようです。また、焼き餃子も人気があります。ランチセットは手頃な価格で、1,000円以下の選択肢が多い点も好評です。スタッフの親切なサービスや、PayPayやSuicaなど多様な支払い方法に対応している点も評価されています。

rv.t: Nice restaurant to sit in and have good taiwanese food. Especially the lunch deal is very good. Recommend the dumplings noodles
Very cute place with amazing food, we got ramen, gyoza, buns and fried eggplant, everything was very good and fresh, big portions, we enjoyed a lot, thank you! 🙏
Delicious lunch menu at a very competitive price. The service was also kind.

2362.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2363.a: Café Tōa Supply, 2F, 1 Chome-7-9 Monzennakacho, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0048, Japan
2363.aj: 〒135-0048 東京都江東区門前仲町１丁目７−９ 2F カフェ東亜サプライ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2363.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee, classic dishes like omurice and curry, and homemade baked cheesecake, with many noting the reasonable prices. They also highlight the retro, spacious, and non-smoking atmosphere, as well as the spotless restrooms. Some reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
2363.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、おいしいコーヒー、オムライスやカレーといった昔ながらの料理、手作りのベイクドチーズケーキが高く評価されており、手頃な価格だという声が多くあります。また、レトロで広々とした禁煙の空間や、清潔なトイレも好評のようです。 一方で、スタッフの対応が頼りにならないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Cafe Toa Supply in Monzen-nakacho is a retro-style coffee shop close to the station, serving carefully brewed specialty coffee and classic dishes like omurice and curry at reasonable prices. The spacious, nostalgic interior is fully non-smoking, which makes it comfortable for everyone to relax from morning through dinner, whether visiting alone or with friends.

Very local retro coffee shop in Monzen-Nakacho area,which is more a localize area in Tokyo. This cafe offers many high quality coffee and all are hand-dripped. Customers here seems to be all senior locals

We stumbled across this cafe on our second day staying here. While the breakfast options are limited the coffee was exceptional. We got the buttered toast and it came with jam, the toast was thick and fluffy. The staff were lovely and patient given we are from Australia; they also have an English version of the menu. If I could give 10 stars I definitely would; the atmosphere was calm and not too busy, for 2 Coffees…

2364.a: Tsukahara, 塚原ビル 13-14 Takabashi, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0005, Japan
2364.aj: 〒135-0005 東京都江東区高橋１３−１４ 塚原ビル つかはら

rv.t: Definitively the second-worst coffee shop I've ever been to. Unfortunately I sat down and ordered a cup of coffee before taking a breath. When I did inhale I was hit by an overpowering smell of mildew - a musty miasma only accentuated by the fact that the place must have been filled with smokers during the first 50 years of its existence. It's definitely old school, with tables and chairs almost comically low to the…

江東区 都営線森下駅から 清澄通りを歩くと 高橋商店街、夜店通りともいう のらくろの水泡さんゆかりの地でもあるので のらくろードとなっている 朝行ったら 朝市？の準備しててにぎやかでした。土日祝にやるみたい？？ 喫茶つかはら モーニングサービスやってます。 昔馴染みのモーニング♪ 禁煙で現金のみのお支払い お店のなかも 昭和感ばっちりで、どこか懐かしい雰囲気 お店のお父さんが よたよた。。出てきたので 手早くモーニングのBセットを注文♪ 手描きのメニューが良いね 喫茶店メニュー豊富です。 ランチも日替わりで、ドリンク付きで８００円って 昭和時間のままみたい。 Bセットハムサンドに、ゆで玉子かサラダが付きます。 どっち？って、お父さんに聞かれて サラダ～♪ コーヒーとね。 モーニング５００円って・・お安いじゃありませんか 朝８時半から１１時まで。 コーヒーも美味しい♪ サラダに ゆで玉子入ってて・・お得感ある ハムサンド…

森下駅から少し歩くと商店街ぽい所にあまり目立たない 看板があります。 外観はそれとなく喫茶店かな？くらいで中に入ると オールド感たっぷりのソファシートと小さめテーブル 程よい暗さの照明で落ち着く店内。 モーニングを注文。3種類あってサンドイッチとゆで卵とコーヒーのセットにしました。 500円とは思えないボリュームで嬉しくいただきました。 軽食やランチも充実してそうなメニューとデザート系もチラホラ書いていたので何回か来てみたいお店です。

2365.a: NESCAFÉ Harajuku, 1 Chome-22-8 Jingumae, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan
2365.aj: 〒150-0001 東京都渋谷区神宮前１丁目２２−８ ネスカフェ 原宿
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2365.ed: Airy space popular for working by WiFi, with touchpads for customers to order coffee & dessert.
2365.edj: Wi-Fi を利用して仕事もできることで人気の、広い店。タッチパッドでコーヒーやデザートを注文する。

rv.t: **menu ordered:** chicken breast & cheese open sandwich + coffee ¥1,188 (inc. tax) there's a lot of drink options to choose from, with soy/oat milk available at no extra fee, which is incredible. the sandwich was pretty good with a lot of cheese. i just wished they had some spicy sauce available (tabasco, sriracha, or something) - the south-east asian in me needed some kick. i've always wanted to try it, and it…

The least crowded part of Harajuku where you can enjoy drinks, sweets and afternoon chit-chat with your friends. The place also works well if you need to be on your laptop or just read a book. The place is spacious and relaxing. People are talking but not that distracting.

“Relaxing, because it’s a little bit distant from the hustle and bustle of Takeshita Street and the ambiance is soothing and conducive for conversation and taking a break. “Convenient, because the payment system is cashless “Fun”, because customers can make their customized Nescafé coffee bottle, the “Hero Bottle Project”.

2365.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2366.a: Tsukuba Station, 2 Chome-128 Azuma, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0031, Japan
2366.aj: 〒305-0031 茨城県つくば市吾妻２丁目１２８ つくば駅
2366.ed: People say this station is spacious and modern, offering convenient access to shopping, hotels, and parks, with an on-site souvenir shop. They also highlight the clean restrooms and the efficient train service to Akihabara. Some reviews mention the station entrance can be difficult to find.
2366.edj: この駅を利用した人は、広々としていて近代的な雰囲気だと評価しています。ショッピングやホテル、公園へのアクセスが便利で、駅構内にはお土産店もあるようです。また、トイレが清潔であることや、秋葉原への電車がスムーズであることも高く評価されています。 一方で、駅の入り口が分かりにくいというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Tsukuba Station offers fast service, reliable amenities, and is a gateway to Tsukuba’s scientific and cultural destinations. Whether you’re commuting for work, exploring landmarks, or heading out for a day trip, this station provides a smooth and pleasing transit experience.

At journey’s end, Tsukuba opens like a gentle frontier—wide boulevards, shimmering ponds, and Mt. Tsukuba rising with ancient grace beyond the skyline 🌄. The terminus blends science-city sparkle with natural calm, sending travelers onward with a peaceful, horizon-wide breath. Tourist Tip: Buses to Mt. Tsukuba depart here; check ropeway timetable in advance 🚌 Tsukuba Express Tour: From Akihabara’s neon hum to…

There is a sake bar in front of the ticket gate where she can enjoy Ibaraki local sake. People who enter the store thinking they can stop by while waiting for the first rapid train are often disappointed. Be careful not to drink too much. If she doesn't have much time, she recommends killing time at the local product store next door.

2367.a: Mount Tsukuba Keisei Hotel, 1 Tsukuba, Ibaraki 300-4352, Japan
2367.aj: 〒300-4352 茨城県つくば市筑波１ 筑波山京成ホテル
2367.ed: Relaxed hot spring lodging with views of the Kanto Plain, plus a bathhouse, dining & free breakfast.
2367.edj: 関東平野を望むくつろぎの温泉ホテル。大浴場、食事処を併設。朝食込み。

rv.t: I did not stay overnight at the hotel. However me and my family paid for and used the onsen that’s available at the hotel.while the hotel did have a no tattoo policy, I have a tattoo and my husband (Japanese) asked about a private room onsen. The private room was not available and they decided to allow me in the public bath. While the facilities are a little older it looked like they are renovating what they can…

Low key hotel in a beautiful location. Staff are super friendly and efficient. Decor was probably in its prime when installed in the 80’s! I didn’t stay there so can’t comment on the rooms, however the onsen was solid. I was there after hiking up mt. Tsukuba and it was nice to have it all to myself. Totally empty on Monday February 17 2025. There was a large indoor onsen facing trees/mountains and then a smaller…

Good staff service, good room and reasonable price Thanks for making a reservation for the restaurant in Mito The house cleaning woman is very cute I had a good time here thank you all But it’s bit deep in the mountain, the restaurant next to the hotel open hours is 10:00-16:00

2368.a: Tsukuba Onsen KIRARI annex, 614-1 Nishiohashi, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0831, Japan
2368.aj: 〒305-0831 茨城県つくば市西大橋６１４−１ つくば温泉 喜楽里 別邸
2368.ed: Visitors say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including a natural hot spring, carbonated spring, and jet baths, along with a sauna and spacious outdoor area. They also highlight the delicious food, wide variety of menu options, and the attentive, friendly staff. Guests mention the facilities are very clean and well-maintained, and appreciate the complimentary towels and convenient wristband…
2368.edj: この温浴施設を利用した人は、天然温泉や炭酸泉、ジェットバスなど、さまざまな種類の浴槽があることに加え、サウナや広々とした露天風呂がある点を評価しています。また、食事のおいしさや豊富なメニュー、親切で丁寧なスタッフの対応も高く評価されています。施設全体が清潔で手入れが行き届いているという声や、無料のタオル貸し出し、便利なリストバンドでの支払いシステムを評価するクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This onsen has an outdoor bath with natural hot spring water flowing directly from the source, which was one of the highlights of the visit. The water felt very authentic and relaxing. One thing to note is that the crowd information on the official website does not seem to be updated regularly. When I arrived, it was much more crowded than expected, which was a bit surprising. It would be helpful if the congestion…
Nice place to come for a comfortable bath. They have free WiFi. Outdoor bath is great. Towels provided.

A wonderful onsen that made me feel relaxed and at peace. This is truly a great location to visit during the cold winter months as the whole place has heated floors. The atmosphere was very relaxing and the food was good too. The wristbands that we received at the shoe locker were convenient as we could use them to purchase any product or service at the onsen. Once you are ready to leave, you can use that same…

2369.a: Aokiya, 筑波山ホテル 青木屋 753-1 Tsukuba, Ibaraki 300-4352, Japan
2369.aj: 〒300-4352 茨城県つくば市筑波７５３−１ 筑波山ホテル 青木屋
2369.ed: Understated rooms, some with deep soaking tubs, in a relaxed hot spring hotel offering dining.
2369.edj: 飾らない客室を備えたくつろぎの温泉ホテル。一部の客室は露天風呂付き。食事を提供。

rv.t: This was so wonderful and a truly special memory of our trip to Japan. First up - if you have tattoos, you cannot use the public Onsen, however they have limited rooms with open air baths, so you experience the hot spring privately - this is what we did and it was so good! They will provide yukatas, strongly recommend wearing them, if unsure how to wear correctly, please go to reception and ask politely if they can…

Standard ryokan room, clean and comfortable. The room view of the city is gorgeous. Men's ofuro is cozy, but having to walk from the indoor pool to the rotenburo (outdoor) is a bit of an inconvenience. Having some extra towels in the room/bathing area would be convenient.

The environment was nice and quiet. It is not very convenient to get there by public transport. Staff at hotel was kind to drop us at the train station which was much appreciated. Food was good and staff were friendly. Room size was good even for 3 adults.

2370.aj: 〒300-4352 茨城県つくば市筑波 筑波山
2370.ed: Famous, 2,877-foot mountain with two peaks, a cable car, hiking trails & views of Tokyo & Mt. Fuji.
2370.edj: 2 つの頂がある標高 877 m の有名な山。ケーブルカーとハイキング コースがあり、山頂からは東京の街や富士山を遠望する。

rv.t: If you're looking to get away for the day, this is the place. There’s a direct bus from Tsukuba Station that makes it easy. Try to arrive early and plan to leave by 5 PM. The hike is moderate, but expect a bit of a crowd and a 1-hour wait at the peak. Make sure to bring your own drinks along. Highly recommended.
Great view, from the shrine until the peak. Only a couple of rest areas along the way and there are shops on the peak.

It was a steep and challenging mountain top and it has two peaks, male and female. 2 hours hiking at least. Rocky and slippery mountain. We took the cable car and climbed to the top of the female and male tops.

2371.a: Majimaya, 2 Chome-5-4 Nishiasakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0035, Japan
2371.aj: 〒111-0035 東京都台東区西浅草２丁目５−４ 馬嶋屋菓子道具店 かっぱ橋道具街店

rv.t: Majimaya is an absolute must-visit for me every time I travel to Tokyo. As a cookie decorator and baking enthusiast, I simply can’t skip this place. One of my favorite things about the store is the stunning central display filled with cookie cutters. I could spend ages there! They’ve made brilliant use of the space, turning what could have been simple product shelves into something that almost feels like a work of…
Possibly THE best baking supplies shop in Japan. If not, then certainly worth a visit for every cook or baking enthusiast anyway. Over a thousand designs of cookie cutters amongst many other goodies.
Love this shop !! Been over 10 times and make my inspiration fly always and find something new all the time. Staff is friendly and attentive, helpful.

2371.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

2372.a: Asai Shoten / 株式会社 浅井商店, 2 Chome-6-5 Nishiasakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0035, Japan
2372.aj: 〒111-0035 東京都台東区西浅草２丁目６−５ かっぱ橋 浅井商店 / 株式会社 浅井商店

rv.t: Tax free shop. Sells some Japanese and imported product. Opens until 5.30pm Product prices are comparable, some more expensive, some are cheaper. They mostly sell baking products but some kitchen utensils too.

Coffee is also nice and pairs well with the scones. The shop is small with around 10 seats, so I recommend ordering to-go and enjoying them at a nearby park or on the go.

If you were a child of the 90s this was peak American culture! I love that it is so active with skateboarding, rollerblading, weightlifting, DJing, basketball, and vibrant colors. There is no better place in the world to people watch! A must see marvel of California!
Venice Beach is One of the many reasons Los Angeles is the most beautiful place in the world! Must visit. Super awesome vibes.

You can stay inside , there is five different hotels , you can take helicopter ride for this area , they have post office here too . There are different points to view the Canyon, it’s so amazing .

This Grand Canyon South Rim Sunset Tour with Dinner deserves more than 5 stars. If I could give it a higher rating, I absolutely would. Our tour guide and owner, Eric, was outstanding. rv.t: LACMA was one of the highlights of my trip to LA. The museum is large, with a wide variety of art to explore. I especially loved the live performance. Impressionism at LACMA was outstanding as well. Particularly Nymphéas by Claude Monet was…

The museum features an impressive collection of famous artworks, and the galleries are spacious, clean, and well organized. Plan to spend at least a full day here if you want to enjoy everything at a relaxed pace. Even with plenty of visitors, it never felt too crowded or noisy, making it a…

rv.t: Omicho Market is one of those places that captures the heart of a city. It feels authentic and local, with a wonderful mix of seafood vendors, fruit and vegetable stalls, speciality shops and small eateries. The quality and freshness of the produce on display are remarkable. From enormous…

Omicho Market is a good place in Kanazawa for seafood. It may not be as comfortable as a restaurant, but the quality makes up for it. There are many stalls, and I think everyone will find something they like. We've been there twice. The service was great and the food was delicious. Warmest regards to the woman in the photo! We love fresh oysters and eat them all over the world. We can honestly say that the oysters…

Omicho Market One of the highlights of Kanazawa and probably the best place in the city to experience local food culture. The market has a very authentic atmosphere, mixing tourists with local residents shopping for fresh seafood, vegetables and traditional products. Walking through the narrow aisles feels lively and energetic, especially in the morning when the stalls are fully operating. The seafood selection is…

Beautifully curated exhibition, which as ever only a small sum was charged to see it. There was also a facinating display by natural treasure —Matsuda Gonroku, his tiny & perfect…

When we visited the museum was holding an exhibition of Lalique. While most of the items were from the museum’s collection it was slightly disappointing as we’re hoping to see more traditional crafts. There was a fascinating small feature on lacquer ware. Only half the museum building is currently in use and the book collection was closed when we visited. The gift store has some very nice items- well curated…

Gon Matsuda laquer show recreated his working environment- accompanied by a great video - showing the artist’s at work- - plus French Lalique glass show - illustrating the influence of art deco on Lalique’s art - great show as well as a historical evolution of his work from Jeweler to perfume bottles creations to purely glass.

2395.ed: A small shrine is located at the southern end of this picturesque lake famous for its morning mists.
2395.edj: 朝霧で有名な美しい湖。南端に小さな神社がある。

rv.t: A Picturesque, Magical Escape in Yufuin – Simply Stunning! ​We came to Lake Kinrin for a stroll right after a lovely lunch, and it turned out to be the perfect highlight of our day. Though it’s a relatively short walk, every single angle looks like a living postcard. ​The water was unexpectedly clear—we even spotted a massive, vibrant golden koi swimming right up near the edge! What makes this walk truly unique is…

Lake Kinrin is one of the most peaceful and picturesque spots in Yufuin, offering a calm atmosphere that feels almost dreamlike. Although the lake itself is not very large, its beauty lies in the details and the unique ambiance that surrounds it. What makes Lake Kinrin especially special is the way it changes throughout the day. In the early morning, a gentle mist often rises from the surface of the water, created…

We arrived in Yufuin in the evening, so we saw the lake view at sunset. There weren't many tourists; it was quiet and peaceful, perfect for a stroll, and it made me feel calm and content. If you're driving, I recommend parking in the public parking lot and walking here, as there aren't many parking options near the lake, and the roads are very narrow and not suitable for driving.

2396.a: 阿蘭草仔粿, No. 90, Jishan St, Chongwen Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan 224
2396.aj: 阿蘭草仔粿, No. 90, Jishan St, Chongwen Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, 台湾 224
2396.ed: People say this snack shop offers delicious, soft, and chewy mugwort rice cakes with various flavorful fillings like savory dried radish and sweet red bean, all at an affordable price of NT$20 per piece. Other reviews mention the service can be impolite and the food can be inconsistent.

rv.t: Takeaway shop. Only NT$20 per mochi. First experience with salted mochi; a very good, soft, chewy, freshly-made mochi. Taro: Salty & Peppery, with Actual Taro Cubes. Mungbean: This one was a tad too salty on its own, so alternate it with other flavours! Comes with Mungbean paste filling. Some people might need mochis to be sweet but i absolutely loved it!

I have fond memories of visiting Jiufen with my family more than 20 years ago and trying their rice cakes back then, so I was looking forward to returning during my recent trip to Taiwan. Their rice cakes were enjoyable, but they weren't particularly memorable. There are many places throughout Taiwan that offer similar, if not better, quality. That said, it's still a pleasant snack to have while exploring Jiufen…
It’s not quite worth waiting in line for, but it’s fun to grab one and give it a casual try.

2397.a: 224, Taiwan, New Taipei City, Ruifang District, Yongqing Village, Jishan St, 28之2號九份金枝紅糟肉圓(二店）
2397.aj: 224 台湾 New Taipei City, Ruifang District, Yongqing Village, Jishan St, 28之2號 九份金枝紅糟肉圓(二店）
2397.ed: Diners like this eatery's red yeast rice Taiwanese meatballs (hong zao rou yuan) and various fish ball soups, noting the convenience of self-service ordering and clean restrooms. Other reviews mention the rouyuan skin can be soft and mushy, and the service can be impolite.

rv.t: Really enjoyed it. The vinasse Taiwanese meatballs are delicious. They are gelatinous on the outside with a delicious pork and bamboo filling that goes perfectly together. I also really enjoyed the fish balls especially the kimchi flavored one that had a nice kick to it. Take a break, sit down, enjoy the view and have a beer with the wonderful food.

Simple to order using their self-service machine. Arrived at 7+pm, and they were out of soup, no discounts were given. Ordered the combination balls (65NTD) - squid, bamboo charcoal, kimchi, pork and codfish. Texture was springy, with lots of bite. CP value rather low due to the price. They're worth a try, for the interesting flavours, but not very memorable. The shop has some seating area, and restrooms.
The meat balls are pretty interesting, made with red yeast-fermented rice and then cooked with chicken. The ball wrapping has a nice chewy texture. But there's little to minimum service.

rv.t: Absolutely amazing!! One of the best cream puffs I've ever had! The portion is so big enough for sharing between 3-4 people. The taro paste is rich, smooth, fragrant not too sweet and you can still taste chunks of the taro in it. The pastry is flaky, airy, crispy and just the right amount of buttery. Sweet potato flavour was just as rich but a bit sweeter than taro. Original cream is a must try!!!! 10/10 I would…
Flaky puff but very average cream. Not too sweet which is great. 65TWD. Take the reviews here with pinch of salt because they reward you with a snack if you give a 5 star on the spot

Passing through Misty dessert kingdom just before we went back to Taipei. We ordered creamy puffs & chocolate puffs for take away. The filling was thick, dense & creamy. The portion was super generous. It was nice for an afternoon snack. 1 puff was a bit too much for me. I preferred the light and airy custard style.

2399.a: A-Zhu Peanut Ice Cream Roll, No. 20號, Jishan St, Yongqing Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan 224
2399.aj: 阿珠雪在焼 No. 20號, Jishan St, Yongqing Village, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, 台湾 224
2399.ed: Reviewers praise the unique peanut ice cream roll featuring fresh cilantro, shaved peanut brittle, and a thin, chewy wrap. They also appreciate the reasonable price and quick service. Some reviews mention the ice cream quality can be poor.

rv.t: You may think it’s weird, but it works. Grated peanut brittle with ice cream and a hint of cilantro, all wrapped in a handmade spring roll wrapper (often called popiah skin or a thin flour crepe). It’s not overly sweet—just the way I like it. A unique cold treat that’s perfect while strolling through Jiufen. Definitely a must-try!

Peanut ice cream — and honestly, it was so good. I mean, ice cream with peanuts? Hard to go wrong. In Taiwan, these small street bites that aren’t quite a full meal are called xiaochi (小吃). Grabbing one and sharing it between the three of us while strolling the streets turned out to be one of those simple, perfect travel moments 👍

This place is so popular. The ice cream is served with peanut and cilantro, which sounded a bit strange to me at first, but it actually works surprisingly well. It’s quite refreshing, especially after walking a lot and feeling tired. A nice treat to cool down while exploring. The staff is really nice and friendly
